name: DisequalityDispersion.route_eval_payload
typeText:
∀ {V F B : Type} {arity : F → Nat}
  (pred : DisequalityDispersion.Term V F arity → Option.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Term V F arity)) (b₀ : B) (a : V → B)
  (z : V) (t : DisequalityDispersion.Term V F arity),
  DisequalityDispersion.Routed pred z t →
    Eq.{1}
      (DisequalityDispersion.Term.eval (DisequalityDispersion.routeTable pred b₀)
          (DisequalityDispersion.taggedSources a) t).2
      (a z)

source.code:
theorem route_eval_payload (pred : Term V F arity → Option (Term V F arity)) (b₀ : B)
    (a : V → B) (z : V) (t : Term V F arity) (hr : Routed pred z t) :
    (t.eval (routeTable pred b₀) (taggedSources a)).2 = a z := by
  classical
  induction hr with
  | start => rfl
  | step f ts j hp h ih =>
      have htags : (fun i => ((ts i).eval (routeTable pred b₀) (taggedSources a)).1) = ts := by
        funext i
        exact route_eval_tag pred b₀ a (ts i)
      change (match pred (.app f (fun i => ((ts i).eval (routeTable pred b₀) (taggedSources a)).1))
        with
        | none => b₀
        | some p => if h : ∃ i, ((ts i).eval (routeTable pred b₀) (taggedSources a)).1 = p then
            ((ts (Classical.choose h)).eval (routeTable pred b₀) (taggedSources a)).2 else b₀) = a z
      rw [htags, hp]
      have hex : ∃ i, ((ts i).eval (routeTable pred b₀) (taggedSources a)).1 = ts j :=
        ⟨j, route_eval_tag pred b₀ a (ts j)⟩
      simp only [dif_pos hex]
      have hspec := Classical.choose_spec hex
      rw [route_eval_tag] at hspec
      rw [hspec]
      exact ih

a : V → B
z : V
t : Term V F arity
f : F
ts : Fin (arity f) → Term V F arity
j : Fin (arity f)
hp : pred (Term.app f ts) = some (ts j)
h : Routed pred z (ts j)
ih : (Term.eval (routeTable pred b₀) (taggedSources a) (ts j)).2 = a z
htags : (fun i => (Term.eval (routeTable pred b₀) (taggedSources a) (ts i)).1) = ts
hex : ∃ i, (Term.eval (routeTable pred b₀) (taggedSources a) (ts i)).1 = ts j
hspec : ts (Classical.choose hex) = ts j
⊢ (Term.eval (routeTable pred b₀) (taggedSources a) (ts j)).2 = a z
